scope: Opaque packed-data bank leaf only; no quantization arithmetic, model, DMA engine or full-bank-pool integration.
reference_observation: Four independent 128-bit write ports, each with its own native row address; one common-row 512-bit read. The referenced design uses memory read latency 2.
clock_reset: aclk; synchronous active-low aresetn resets metadata and read pipeline, does not erase memory. Writes blocked during reset.
write_interface: ena_i[PORT_COUNT], addra_i[PORT_COUNT][ADDR_WIDTH], dina_i[PORT_COUNT][PORT_DATA_WIDTH], wea_i[PORT_COUNT][PORT_DATA_WIDTH/8]. Enabled byte writes in range are accepted every clock independently, without arbitration.
read_interface: enb_i, addrb_i[ADDR_WIDTH]; doutb_o[PORT_COUNT*PORT_DATA_WIDTH]. Each stripe reads its common native row.
read_latency: READ_LATENCY clocks from the accepting rising edge through memory output; reuse the existing uram_bank contract and align any read-valid metadata to the actual XPM pipeline. Disabled read output holds after accepted requests drain.
throughput: Up to four 128-bit stripe writes and one 512-bit combined read per clock; II=1 for the default configuration. No arbitrary four-read-address support.
mapping: doutb_o[p*PORT_DATA_WIDTH +: PORT_DATA_WIDTH] is stripe p; addra_i[p] and addrb_i use native stripe rows, not global byte addresses. A common row contains 128 packed INT4 elements at the default width; scale metadata layout remains separate and pending.
primitive: One shared ip/infrastructure/datamover_engine/rtl/uram_bank.sv instance per stripe; do not change this existing primitive or its frozen contract.
read_during_write: The common uram_bank read_first behavior; byte writes affect only enabled bytes in their stripe.
address_policy: Suppress physical enables outside [0,DEPTH); expose per-stripe wr_address_error_o and common rd_address_error_o for enabled out-of-range requests. Full-width range check before narrowing protects against high-bit aliasing.

commit_policy.output: commitb_o[ADDR_WIDTH:0] is the exclusive complete-row prefix shared by all stripes, the minimum per-stripe prefix.
commit_policy.update: Advance a stripe prefix only on an in-range full-byte-strobe write exactly at its current prefix row. Other accepted memory writes do not advance the prefix. Older rewrites and holes cannot overstate commit.
commit_policy.clear: clear_commit_i takes priority for all prefix counters and starts a new metadata epoch; suppress writes on the clear edge. Memory contents are retained. Read pipeline is reset only by aresetn; epoch drain/ownership remains the external caller responsibility.
commit_policy.out_of_order: Writes above a hole may update memory but require replay in prefix order before being published; no hidden coverage bitmap.
commit_policy.width: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits represent DEPTH even when it fills the native address space; no last-row wrap.

parameter_policy: Positive byte-aligned PORT_DATA_WIDTH, PORT_COUNT>=1, DEPTH>=1, READ_LATENCY>=1, ADDR_WIDTH sufficient for DEPTH. Parameter errors must fail simulation, rather than synthesize an apparently usable bank.
verification_required: Actual XPM XSIM with source closure, source hashes, raw compile/elaborate/simulation logs and exit codes.
Four same-clock independent write addresses; common-row read concatenation and packed-nibble lane order.
Byte masks, first/last legal rows, out-of-range/high-bit alias suppression, full-address-space commit count.
II1 back-to-back reads, configured latency 2 and 3, read disabled hold, read-first collision, reset with requests in flight and retained memory.
Unequal producer progress, partial write, skipped row, older rewrite, clear/reset, exact minimum commit and no unsafe prefix advancement.
Strict lint against the actual leaf closure, separate from simulation stubs.
Vivado 2025.2 default real-depth OOC synthesis at a declared 5ns clock; no black boxes; real URAM mapping and resource report. Do not claim routed/board timing from synthesis.
not_claimed: Routed timing, BIT generation or physical-board behavior
